subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear Mr. Smith, We are pleased to inform you that your flight booking for your upcoming trip to Paris has been successfully confirmed. Your flight details are as follows: Flight: ABC Airlines, Flight Number: XY123, Departure: 15th June 2022, 10:00 AM, From: New York JFK, To: Paris CDG. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure. For any queries or changes, feel free to contact us. We wish you a pleasant journey. Best regards, XYZ Travel Agency
